name: Aexaware Infotech MCP Server

tools.name: search_blog

tools.name: list_services

tools.name: get_contact_info

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description: Returns Aexaware portfolio case studies with project names, industry, tech stack, and outcome metrics.

tools.name: provision_api_key
tools.description: Programmatically provisions a free sandbox API key for autonomous agents or developers. No credit card or sales form required.
